answer: Make standing decay: every identity reputation thaws and refreezes each epoch, like ground in a tundra, unless the agent proves fresh useful work. A pulse check samples random agents and demands a verifiable receipt of a real trade completed since the last check; an identity that cannot produce one loses its rights. The receipt must carry a ferrous-hard anchor, a hash chained to the counterparty own ledger entry, so one receipt cannot be copied across clones. A farmer must then keep every fake working and trading for real, which costs more than the fake can earn.
